plan.purpose: Attribute long-tail gains to sampling, training loss and decision thresholds.

benchmark.caveat: Real data, checkpoint I/O and changing shared-machine load add uncertainty.

protocol.checkpoint_selection: check Macro-AUPR, threshold-free; identical for all five methods
threshold_conditions: per-label exact F1 over observed calibration scores, ties choose lowest threshold

training_methods.label_sampler: uniform label mixture: probability proportional to sum(y_c/n_positive_c), replacement
training_methods.combo_sampler: probability proportional to inverse combination count, replacement
training_methods.logit_adjustment: uniform identities; BCE(z+logit(pi),y), tau=1; evaluate raw z, no second correction

protocol.data_pool: fresh v3 same-physics distribution, Python PCG64 port, not MATLAB RNG parity
protocol.report_role: fresh predeclared reporting identities; no report metrics until every fixed training job completes
protocol.tail_label_definition: lowest two fit positive counts, fixed before training
protocol.rare_combo_definition: all combinations attaining the minimum fit combination count; keep every tie
effects: calibrated minus fixed within each model
difference of calibration gains versus BCE

interpretation: The paired seed interval conditions on this fixed fresh pool. It is not uncertainty over simulator implementations or new datasets.
